board.summary: Bad Left Hook's current Aug. 29 slate remains the actionable pool. A fresh fight-week sweep found no PLAY. Cameron remains the strongest thesis, but +220 is still short of the +240 entry; the best three-way market normalizes to about +240 no-vig. Hrgovic can still be found as high as +700, with many US books shorter, so +750 remains the trigger. Berinchyk is still capped around +450 against a +500 target. Martinez's moneyline remains heavily taxed and no defensible KO/TKO quote was verified. O2 event metadata was refreshed to the published 10:30 AM PT main-card start.

cards.movement: BEST PRICE STILL +220 · TARGET NOT REACHED
cards.rationale: Bad Left Hook still frames this as an elite, competitive unification, and fresh fight-week coverage reinforces Cameron's confidence rather than exposing a new negative. Best market +220 implies 31.3%; using best three-way prices, the market normalizes to roughly 29.4% for Cameron, about +240 fair. The thesis survives, but there is not enough cushion to upgrade before +240 or better.

cards.market: MAYER vs CAMERON · METHOD OF VICTORY
cards.movement: METHOD PRICE STILL +370 · NO IMPROVEMENT TO ENTRY BAND
cards.rationale: The ten-round, two-minute-round title format and both fighters' recent decision-heavy profiles keep the decision angle viable, but +370 still does not compensate enough for method-market hold and outcome variance. Keep the angle, reject the current quote, and require roughly +450 or better.

cards.movement: BEST MARKET +700 · US BOOKS RANGE ABOUT +450 TO +650
cards.rationale: Bad Left Hook's upset case remains Hrgovic's experience, size, durability and ability to test dimensions Itauma has not yet had to prove. Fight-week reporting still shows bookmakers willing to reach +700, but the best three-way market normalizes to about +708 fair, so +700 itself is not an edge. Require +750 or better before a second-pass upgrade.

cards.rationale: Bad Left Hook rates Martinez as a legitimate 168-pound contender and notes Plantic's amateur pedigree but limited high-level professional testing. The only potentially useful route remains a stoppage prop at a defensible price; no current KO/TKO quote was verified, so there is no play.
